    CASE ac."conserve_status"
      WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
      WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
      WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
      WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
      WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
      ELSE 5
    END as conserve_status_val
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
  LEFT JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ac."ARTregID" = ar."ART_link"
),
sensitivity_map AS (
  SELECT 
    sd."ART_link",
    CASE COALESCE(sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->>'light', 'Medium')
      WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END as light_sens_wt,
    CASE COALESCE(sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->>'temperature', 'Medium')
      WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END as temp_sens_wt,
    CASE COALESCE(sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->>'humidity', 'Medium')
      WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END as humid_sens_wt
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
),
showcase_light AS (
  SELECT 
    "CA"."art_exam",
    AVG("LR"."lux") as avg_lux,
    AVG("LR"."visLxh") as avg_vislxh
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" "CA"
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" "ER" ON "CA"."case_exam" = "ER"."case_link"
  JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" "LR" ON "ER"."monitor_code" = "LR"."env_link"
  GROUP BY "CA"."art_exam"
),
usage_data AS (
  SELECT 
    "CA"."art_exam" as art_id,
    MAX("UR"."displayMonths") as display_months
  FROM "UsageRecords" "UR"
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" "ER" ON "UR"."env_link" = "ER"."monitor_code"
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" "CA" ON "ER"."case_link" = "CA"."case_exam"
  GROUP BY "CA"."art_exam"
),
base_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    ar."ARTregID",
    ar."art_title",
    ar."MatKind",
    -- CPI
    ((COALESCE(ar."HIST_sign", 0) + ar.research_score + ar.cultural_score) * (10 - ar.conserve_status_val)) / 30.0 as cpi,
    -- DSD
    (36.0 * (10 - COALESCE(sm.light_sens_wt, 5)) * (10 - COALESCE(sm.temp_sens_wt, 5)) * (10 - COALESCE(sm.humid_sens_wt, 5))) / 1000.0 as dsd,
    -- LER
    COALESCE(sl.avg_lux, 0) * COALESCE(sm.light_sens_wt, 5) * COALESCE(sl.avg_vislxh, 0) / 1000.0 as ler,
    -- display months
    COALESCE(ud.display_months, 0) as display_months,
    -- organic flag
    CASE WHEN ar."MatKind" IN ('Textile', 'Wood', 'Paper') THEN true ELSE false END as is_organic
  FROM artifact_ratings ar
  LEFT JOIN sensitivity_map sm ON ar."ARTregID" = sm."ART_link"
  LEFT JOIN showcase_light sl ON ar."ARTregID" = sl."art_exam"
  LEFT JOIN usage_data ud ON ar."ARTregID" = ud.art_id
)
SELECT

  "art_title",
  "MatKind",
  ROUND(CAST(cpi AS numeric), 2) as cpi,
  ROUND(CAST(dsd AS numeric), 2) as dsd,
  ROUND(CAST(ler AS numeric), 2) as ler,
